title: A Carolina dogwood
done: You made a dogwood! It is the state flower of North Carolina.

steps.say: Put a green square flat on the table. It is the middle.
Put a yellow square on the left. Dogwood flowers are white; we use yellow.
Put a yellow square on the right.
Put a yellow square on top.
Put a yellow square at the bottom. Four petals!
Put a small green triangle at the bottom left. A leaf.
Put a small green triangle at the bottom right.
